proposal.summary: Improper Authentication vulnerability in ABB Symphony Plus S+ Operations affecting multiple 2.x and 3.x versions.
proposal.affected_product: Symphony Plus S+ Operations: from 2.X through 2.1 SP2, 2.2, from 3.X through 3.3 SP1, 3.3 SP2
proposal.recommended_next_step: Request full advisory or vendor report with technical details: attack prerequisites, authentication bypass technique, impacted components, reproducible proof-of-concept, and recommended mitigations or patches.

evidence_quotes.quote: Improper Authentication vulnerability in ABB Symphony Plus S+ Operations.
This issue affects Symphony Plus S+ Operations: from 2.X through 2.1 SP2, 2.2, from 3.X through 3.3 SP1, 3.3 SP2.
